crossRefs.note: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.
It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to…
For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing…
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

translations.web: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
translations.bsb: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
translations.kjv: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
translations.asv: And I gave you a land whereon thou hadst not labored, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell therein; of vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
